column1: # Mobile network codes (MNC) under each MCC and the network named for each one.
# Source: ITU TSB, "Mobile Network Codes (MNC) for the international identification plan for public networks and
#   subscriptions (According to Recommendation ITU-T E.212 (09/2016))", Annex to ITU Operational Bulletin No. 1162
#   (15.XII.2018), position on 15 December 2018. Published by ITU as T-SP-E.212B-2018,
#   https://www.itu.int/dms_pub/itu-t/opb/sp/T-SP-E.212B-2018-PDF-E.pdf. Rows under the shared codes 901 and 902 are from the
#   same annex. Names are the network names as the list prints them (public names only; no other data is taken).
# Where the list repeats a code for its use in a second country (extra-territorial use, Annex E of E.212), the row of the
#   country that owns the MCC is kept. Amendments published after 15 December 2018 are not applied.
# The MNC keeps its digits as printed: "01" (two digits) and "001" (three digits) are different codes.
# Update: take the newest annex from https://www.itu.int/itu-t/bulletin/annex.html and apply later amendments.
